name: Zero One
source:
Nagoya always suffers from mysterious dreams. One day he is invited by his classmates on a drinking party to celebrate the last day of semester. They hear piano playing at night school. Depending on actions, the mystery can have four absolutely different and often fantastic reasons.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-april-2003-zanmataisei.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
名古屋总是做着神秘的梦。某天，同班同学邀请他参加庆祝学期结束的饮酒会。夜晚，他们听见学校里传来钢琴声。根据行动不同，这个谜团可能有四个截然不同、常常不可思议的答案。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-april-2003-zanmataisei.html]vndreview[/url]]
